race.comment: THAT'S OKAY (1) rocketed out of the inside draw with a strong early sectional and gave a sight but had to settle for a placing, finishing second (17.53) at this track over 300m. Sure to be about the mark. REDEEM A ARCADIA (7) turned in a moderate run last time when seventh at this track over 300m behind Stormy Bella (18.03) in a Grade 5. Was a winner the start prior. Deserves plenty of respect. TRUE BLUE BILLY (3) charged out of the inside draw with a fast early sectional but swamped late when a close up fourth (17.44) at this track over 300m. Must be included in calculations. DOLLY DAWN (6) racing over this course and distance brings the best out in her.
